ops.title: Support SYSTEM.md and APPEND_SYSTEM.md
ops.body: Follow-up to #51 ([comparison](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/51#issuecomment-6863264436)). pi lets a project or user replace or extend its system

ops:
prompt (`resource-loader.js`, `discoverSystemPromptFile` / `discoverAppendSystemPromptFile`):

| File | Effect in pi | Lookup |
|---|---|---|
| `SYSTEM.md` | Replaces pi's own sections (preamble, tools, rules, docs) as `customPrompt`. `project_context`, `skills`, `cwd`, and extension sections still foll
